description: Model routing policy. Pairs with runtime-policy.json. Goal: with local LLM optional, cost/quota is the new bottleneck (not VRAM). Route cheap by default, expensive only when needed.

route-classify.reason: high volume, low difficulty -> cheapest path

local-optional.constraint: <=8b only (8GB VRAM). One model at a time. NOT for parallel sub-agents.

guardrails.note: Hermes orchestrator must not fan out unbounded paid calls. run() approval gate (adapter interface) applies.

notes: Designed by Claude (brain). Codex wires routing into Hermes config + adapter layer. Tune maxConcurrentWorkers to your API quotas.
